items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma derives the long exact cohomology sequence of the blow-up square for torsion coefficients (statement lines 23387-23407). The proof (proof lines 23409-23418) takes the cohomological descent triangle of the square and identifies the global sections of its pushforward terms, giving the displayed sequence. H2: one triangle plus one identification.
